title: Template Studio
lead: A section for pack authors: edit templates and propose changes to the packs repository. The git host decides on merging.

section.title: Section
section.enabledHint: Only people with the “Template author” right and installation administrators see the section.
section.locked: The switch is set by the server environment.

grants.title: “Template author” right
grants.lead: Who can open the section. Installation administrators always have it.
grants.emptyLead: Grant it to a person or an organization group.

grant.title: Grant the “Template author” right
grant.lead: To a person or a whole organization group: new group members get the right automatically.

service.title: Service access
service.lead: An instance-level token for a pack repository: workspaces of people with the Template author right push branches with it, commits are signed by the person. One access per repository.
service.emptyLead: Without it, template authors use their own tokens.
service.removeLead: Workspaces that use it lose access to the repository.
service.addTitle: Service access to a pack repository
service.addLead: The token is stored encrypted and never shown again. Every use is written to the audit log.
service.label: Label
service.tokenHint: https only. Rights as in the pack repository profile: write, pull requests, checks status.
service.forkModeHint: The branch goes only to the fork of the token account, the PR is opened from the fork. The Studio never pushes into the repository itself. Needs a classic GitHub token with the public_repo scope.

problem.token_rejected: GitHub did not accept the token: it is revoked, expired or mistyped.
problem.fine_grained_token: This is a fine-grained token: GitHub does not let it open a PR in someone else's repository. Create a classic token with the public_repo scope.
problem.scope_missing: The token has no public_repo (or repo) scope: the fork and the PR will fail.
problem.fork_unavailable: The fork could not be found or created. Check the token scope and that the account has no repository with the same name.
problem.bot_can_push: The bot account has write access to the official repository. It is not needed: the Studio pushes only to the fork anyway, but better remove it.

official.title: Official packs
official.lead: The Official packs button in the Pack Studio opens the packs of the Studio repository. Contributing without your own GitHub account goes through a service account (bot): the branch goes only to its fork, the PR is opened from the fork.
official.help: How to set up the bot
official.hidden: No official repository is set (HSE_STUDIO__PACK_STUDIO__OFFICIAL_REPO_URL is empty): there is no Official packs button.
official.botNoFork: Bot: access "{{label}}". The fork appears on the access check or the first proposal.
official.botDirect: The service access to the official repository is not in fork mode: it pushes the branch straight into the repository. For a bot, remove it and add it again with Fork only checked.
official.noBot: No bot is set up: people without a GitHub token cannot propose changes.
official.enabledHint: Turn off so that the bot sends nothing. Proposing with your own token keeps working.
official.limitHint: Against spam in the bot's name. Default {{value}} (HSE_STUDIO__PACK_STUDIO__OFFICIAL_BOT_DAILY_LIMIT).
